gloss: to hold back, to drag down

definitions.gloss: to hold back, to drag down, to hinder
definitions.explanation: To impede someone's progress or success, often unintentionally through one's own poor performance or actions.

examples.japanese: ⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足|あし}を{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}らない⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦がんばる→がんばる：01222_ganbaru⟧。
examples.english: I'll do my best not to hold the team back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{失敗|しっぱい}→失敗：01636_shippai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足|あし}を{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}った。
examples.english: His failure dragged down the project.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体調不良|たいちょうふりょう}→体調不良：20233_taichoufuryou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{足|あし}を{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}って⟦しまった→てしまう：03102_teshimau⟧。
examples.english: I ended up holding everyone back because I wasn't feeling well.

examples.japanese: ⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足|あし}を{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}りたく⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦もっと→もっと：00798_motto⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}する→練習：05323_renshuu⟧。
examples.english: I don't want to drag everyone down, so I'll practice more.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦チーム→チーム：03858_chiimu⟧⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{足|あし}を{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。⟦{責任|せきにん}→責任：03298_sekinin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: One person's mistake can drag down the whole team. Let's work responsibly.

notes:
STRUCTURE: ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (leg/foot) + ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ + ⟦{引|ひ}っ{張|ぱ}る→引っ張る：02402_hipparu⟧ (to pull). Literally 'to pull someone's leg' - but unlike the English idiom, this means hindering, not joking.

NUANCE: Often used when someone unintentionally burdens others through:
- Poor performance
- Mistakes
- Being unprepared
- Health or personal issues

USAGE:
- Team sports and group work
- Business projects
- Family situations
- Any collaborative effort

SELF-DEPRECATING USE: Commonly used humbly about oneself when worried about being a burden.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{邪魔|じゃま}→邪魔：01610_jama⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to get in the way)
- ⟦{迷惑|めいわく}→迷惑：02432_meiwaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to cause trouble for)
- ⟦{足手|あして}まとい→足手まとい：noentry⟧ (a burden, hindrance)

OTHER ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{足|あし}が{出|で}る→足が出る：06888_ashigaderu⟧: to go over budget
- ⟦{足|あし}を{運|はこ}ぶ→足を運ぶ：06898_ashiwohakobu⟧: to visit
